headline_findings: For x in {0,1}, pointwise G11 abs(w*x) thresholding is exactly the existing static destination-group beta mask after the ordinary zero-event skip; it cannot be counted as a new contribution.
A fixed global top-m list per destination group is also only a static keep mask and has no independent novelty.

A per-token cumulative error budget over the active subset is algorithmically different, but it is only a candidate until a dynamic-decision witness and a same-resource scan/metadata-aware cycle win are both shown.

Existing M51 FC1 and six patch/residual Conv payloads plus the frozen checkpoint are enough for a CPU-only opportunity and ideal-K8 screen; FC2 is not locally replayable because its payloads are absent.

The cumulative-budget mechanism has a serious execution risk: deriving beta from weights reads the data it proposes to skip, while storing ordered beta metadata can be much larger than the existing one-bit static mask and scanning the group-wise order can dominate sparse issue.

definitions.destination_group_weight_bound: beta_ig = max over j in destination group g of abs(Wq_ji)
definitions.g11_contribution_bound: c_tig = max_j abs(Wq_ji * x_ti) = a_ti * beta_ig
definitions.existing_sparse_frontend: a_ti=0 sources are already not issued

formal_collision_proof.threshold_equivalence: For every active source a_ti=1, c_tig <= tau if and only if beta_ig <= tau. Therefore issue_tig = a_ti AND (beta_ig > tau), exactly the M287/M293 static group mask joined with the token activity bitmap.
formal_collision_proof.fixed_top_m_equivalence: If the same m source ranks are removed for every token, top-m is a precomputed source-by-group mask. Token activity only ANDs that mask and does not create a new mechanism.
formal_collision_proof.existing_budget_ledger_collision: M287 and M293 already attach beta times omitted-active-source-count as a conservative per-destination-accumulator integer-domain bound. Renaming it a budget ledger is not novel.
formal_collision_proof.conclusion: G11 source threshold, fixed top-m and beta-count ledger are fully covered by M287/M293/M300 and the M301 modified-forward experiment. They must not be presented as an additional contribution.

distinct_candidate.name: token-dynamic cumulative destination-group error budget
distinct_candidate.arithmetic_domain: frozen symmetric per-output-row INT8 weights with binary x
distinct_candidate.precomputed_bound: beta_ig=max_j abs(Wq_ji) for source i and destination group g
distinct_candidate.precomputed_order: stable ascending beta_ig order per layer and destination group; tie-break by source ID
distinct_candidate.runtime_rule: For token t and group g, walk active sources in the fixed order and drop the maximal prefix whose cumulative sum of beta_ig does not exceed B. Keep the first active source that would exceed B and all later active sources.
distinct_candidate.proof: For every destination j in g, abs(sum over dropped i of Wq_ji*x_ti) <= sum over dropped i of abs(Wq_ji*x_ti) <= sum over dropped active i of beta_ig <= B.
distinct_candidate.b0_behavior: B=0 is exact; it may optionally elide beta_ig=0 tasks as exact zero-weight work, but must match the exact sparse baseline bit-for-bit.
distinct_candidate.why_not_static: The remaining budget depends on which lower-ranked sources are active in this token. The same source/group pair can be dropped in one token and kept in another.
distinct_candidate.mandatory_novelty_witness: At least one identical source/group pair must have different keep decisions on two frozen tokens due solely to earlier active-prefix budget consumption. Without this witness, the measured policy has collapsed to a static mask and is not new.

hardware_execution_audit.budget_width_rule: ceil(log2(Nsource*127+1)) bits in the INT8 bound domain; the full 864-source Conv domain needs 17 bits even though the observed active maximum is 448

group4_metadata_sensitivity.warning: logical metadata count only, not SRAM macro area/energy; bucket coding can reduce it but does not remove scan cost

hardware_execution_audit.weight_read_hazard: If beta_ig is recomputed by reading the destination-group weights before the decision, weight traffic is not skipped and much of the proposed benefit disappears. Beta/order must live in a smaller side metadata path whose SRAM accesses are included in the comparison.
hardware_execution_audit.scan_hazard: A full ordered scan visits Nsource candidates per token/group, while the existing bit-sparse K8 path visits only active sources. At low activity, even a large MAC drop can lose cycles to permutation scan, membership tests and descriptor construction.
hardware_execution_audit.required_same_resource_equation: candidate_cycles = active_capture + order_scan_or_bucketize + beta_metadata + budget_compare + compaction + K8_issue_kept + accumulator_commit; compare against the same-population baseline K8_issue_active + accumulator_commit
